modules.rationale: Foundational alphabet/pronunciation/grammar/numbers scaffolding. No corresponding chapter in Hospitrainity.docx (DEC-001 sole-source). Retain as optional pre-course scaffolding only if approved in CP-06; not authored from the source of truth.
Greeting/welcome and politeness folded into Chapter 2 (Front Desk and Check-In); intro framing also in Chapter 1. Rewritten from DOCX, not ported verbatim (DEC-005).
Reservation verification, policies and requests map directly to Chapter 2. Rewritten from DOCX.
No dedicated chapter in Hospitrainity.docx; amenities appear only as a minor "offer a little extra" phrase set inside Chapter 2. Not a standalone module in the source of truth.
Complaints and problem handling are covered by Chapter 7 (Dealing with Problems and Complaints) and its framework. Rewritten from DOCX.
Check-out/billing is outside the 7-chapter scope of Hospitrainity.docx. Not authored from the source of truth.
Phone customer service maps to Chapter 3 (Dealing with Customers on the Phone); the guest-services hotline is Chapter 4. Rewritten from DOCX.
No emergency chapter in Hospitrainity.docx. Safety-critical escalation is partly reflected in Chapter 7 complaint handling but emergencies are not in the source of truth.
